edits.new: Watch repair is the activity of restoring wristwatches to working order.
edits.old: Watch repair is the activity of restoring timekeepers worn on the wrist to working order.

edits.new: An LCD digital wristwatch is an ordinary wristwatch. Restoring it to working order independently satisfies Watch repair, without importing the counterpart's mechanical definition. The device lacks the required mechanical movement.
edits.old: The instructions restore a timekeeper worn on the wrist to working order, independently satisfying Watch repair. The device lacks the required mechanical movement.
